headline: Traversal round 1 is in Unreal (C++ port of the browser swing system and camera) and the first harsh critic has judged it: FAILS TARGET. Biggest gap: swings are flat, so the builder is making each swing a real vertical pendulum with a camera that follows height.
target: Marvel's Spider-Man 2 quality at 3840×2160 output, 60 fps, measured during real gameplay on the Mac Studio M3 Ultra.

critic.gap: Swings are flat: the hero holds one height down a rail-like corridor. Each swing must drop 2–4 storeys above the street and rise past the anchor, with the camera following height (vanishing point moving ≥15% of frame).
critic.notes: Reference won all four A/B pairs. Secondary: released web sweeps across the lens; camera clips into the hero during wall-run; wall-run has a frozen pose then a T-pose; tricks fire on every release. Scores: arc 3, camera 3, web 3, moves 2, body 2.

perf.what: UE foundation gray-box, hero auto-run (HW ray tracing on)

gaps: Unreal port has only a gray-box test map and a capsule character so far.
No trustworthy 4K/60 numbers yet: the shared GPU is 42–99 % busy with other sessions' Chrome/Blender work.
Default 4K output renders internally at 1920×1080 (50 %, TSR upscale); native 100 % is available via r.ScreenPercentage 100.

log.text: UE 5.8.3 installed; WebHomage project up with the official MCP on port 8765; spawn/remove round-trip verified.
Ownership contract NIGHT1.md committed; five agents launched (F1, F2, F3, P1, P2).
All six agents hit the weekly usage limit and stopped mid-round; nothing lost (uncommitted work kept in each worktree).
Limit reset. Resumed F1, F2, P1. Concurrency capped at three agents.
F1 merged: C++ module, mouse-safe controller (Escape always releases), Lumen + HW ray tracing on Metal SM6, offscreen 4K capture + 60 fps video.
Public fork refuses Git LFS uploads, so Unreal content is now rebuilt from committed scripts; binary snapshots go to the private repo webhomage-unreal-content.
P3 traversal + camera started (C++ port of traversal.js/camera.js with scripted input replays).
P3 round 1 merged; critic verdict FAILS TARGET; builder sent back on the flat-swing gap.
